plan.summary: Fix two INMA SSO integration bugs: (1) Flow Builder iframe shows login instead of inheriting Dashboard session because it reads fb_session from sessionStorage while Dashboard writes to localStorage. (2) Sidebar nav links disappear after navigation because ops-only endpoints return 401 for INMA JWT, triggering aggressive token wipe in executeWithRefresh that clears localStorage while React state still shows authenticated.
plan.q_intent: inma dan direk linkle giris yaptim. flow builder a giris yapinca tekrar login istiyor, dogrudan girmesi lazim. diger sayfalar ornegin kampanyalara girince sol navdaki tum servis linkler kayboluyor.

files_changed.change: loadSession reads localStorage first then sessionStorage

build.output_tail: FlowBuilder: built in 2.00s, Dashboard: built in 5.12s

verification_questions.question: Does Flow Builder loadSession correctly read from localStorage first (where Dashboard writes fb_session) before falling back to sessionStorage?
Does the executeWithRefresh method preserve INMA session tokens when ops endpoints return 401, preventing sidebar nav items from disappearing?
Is there any risk of stale tokens remaining in localStorage for INMA sessions that should have been invalidated (e.g. truly expired JWT)?

non_goals: New API endpoints for tenant analytics

user_facing_errors: Unauthorized error thrown on 401 (caught by callers)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: loadSession returns null on parse failure (safe fallback to login). executeWithRefresh throws Unauthorized (callers handle via catch).
